notes:
## 1.2.0 - November 8, 2026
- RX Scout now remembers your receiver by its MAC address and Yamaha System ID. If its IP address changes, RX Scout finds it on the network and reconnects by itself.
- Alerts when it moves: pop-up, Windows/Android notification, and optional email through your own mail server (Settings > If the IP changes).
- Find by MAC button (Home ribbon and System tab).
- Windows: Keep running in the tray, so it keeps watching after you close the window.
- System tab: Copy MAC button and DHCP reservation tip.
